name: speedrun-race-bot-dev-tools
description: Developer command wrapper for the Python Speedrun Race Bot.

scripts.prettier: prettier --write README.md docs config package.json package-lock.json commitlint.config.cjs --ignore-unknown && poetry run ruff format src tools tests
scripts.prettier:check: prettier --check README.md docs config package.json package-lock.json commitlint.config.cjs --ignore-unknown && poetry run ruff format --check src tools tests
scripts.lint: poetry run ruff check src tools tests && npm run prettier:check
